description: This file contains utility functions for reading a file into memory and printing its contents along with some test-specific memory handling. It defines functions related to file reading, memory management, and output formatting, primarily used in unit tests.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads a specified file into a provided memory buffer structure, handling errors and ensuring proper null-termination.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the contents of a file fetched into memory and optional KVP data to standard output for testing and debugging purposes.
